name: scheduled-chat-continuation-gate
principle: A local job or transport failure is not a run stop condition. Preserve the affected result, classify the failure, then continue with the next independent ready job whenever possible.

backlog_policy.rule: Record-bank count and Drive pending count are transport-state metrics, not research-capacity limits. If a complete result can be durably checkpointed to Drive, continue independent research even when no direct GitHub bank is selectable.

probe_success.action: checkpoint the affected complete logical payload to Google Drive outbox, leave its GitHub job incomplete, continue independent work, and allow later unrelated GitHub writes

probe_failure.action: disable further GitHub writes for the remainder of this run; checkpoint each completed logical payload to Google Drive outbox and continue read/research/audit work

end_of_run_gate.rule: Before emitting a final response or ending voluntarily, evaluate stop_run_only_if. Unsent-paper count, Drive backlog size, a dirty bank, or exhaustion of all fixed banks does not satisfy STOP_RUN while complete results can still be durably saved to Drive and independent work exists.
